cause.runtimeConstruction: src/consensus_capella_runtime.cpp:125-128 loads only the authenticated CapellaForkStore; reactor.cpp:323 publishes initial with empty archive.
cause.beaconReads: src/consensus_capella_reactor.cpp:422-427 requires independently persisted checkpoint_archive; capella_beacon_api.cpp:163 returns 404 when absent.
cause.expectedExistingBehavior: include/nano/consensus_capella_reactor.hpp:195-197,244-246 explicitly permits unsigned trusted anchors. tests/test_capella_transition.cpp:1244 asserts no fabricated archived anchor.

duplicateIngestionCannotRepair.reason: reactor.cpp:484-496 returns existing-root acknowledgement without authenticating/installing signed archive bytes; lines564-565 expressly forbid backfill through duplicate fast path.

safeAvailablePrimitives.lowLevelContract: storage.hpp:72-97 trusts caller validation; digest is integrity, not consensus authentication. Do not directly write archive DB keys or bypass reactor.

recommendedScopeCorrection.action: In pure public observer, treat only the still-original externally authenticated baseline checkpoint as no advancement BEFORE requesting a signed finalized header. No 404 catch/fallback.
recommendedScopeCorrection.gate: state.epoch equals baseline.epoch, state.root equals baseline.root, perOwnerPreviousEpoch equals baseline.epoch; a conflict or regression is refused.
recommendedScopeCorrection.retainedRequirements: Every later checkpoint requires both authentic canonical/nonoptimistic/finalized signed header reads and bounded verified ancestry; baseline never contributes progress or stable samples.
tests: Initial exact baseline without archive requires no header request and no progress.
Different root at baseline epoch is refused.
A later finalized checkpoint missing its signed archive (404) is fatal.
Return to baseline after completed future observation is refused.
Repeated baseline readings do not add stable finality samples.

ifSignedAnchorServingIsRequired.change: Introduce explicit local pinned anchor-archive import, separate from peer duplicate admission.
ifSignedAnchorServingIsRequired.validation: Bound exact wire SHA and trusted root/token; parse canonical SSZ body/header; require equality to authenticated retained header/state; verify existing proposer BLS signature/domain; reject substitutions, unknown roots and conflict with immutable archived bytes.
ifSignedAnchorServingIsRequired.publication: Atomically publish same fork/execution/finality/clock state plus one authenticated archive and witness intent under current exact CAS pins; no signer callback.
tests: Valid manifest wire serves identical SSZ/header after import and cold reopen.
Bad signature/body/root/domain/hash and stale token refuse before durable writes.
Same wire idempotence; conflicting archive never overwrites.
Cancellation before durable intent and witness/primary boundary reopen preserve safety.
Peer duplicate path continues never installing missing archive.
